title: DECISION: first-match-wins semantics correctly implemented in GroupFilter
description: GroupFilter::accepts() iterates patterns in order and returns the outcome of the first matching pattern immediately, without scanning remaining patterns. This is the correct semantics for NNTP wildmat filters (INN, diablo, and similar servers all use first-match-wins). An incorrect implementation (e.g. last-match-wins, or AND-all patterns) would silently misroute articles when negation patterns are interleaved with positive patterns. The tests groupfilter_negation_excludes_first_match and groupfilter_positive_after_negation_miss verify this ordering property directly.
